links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified AAOS OrthoInfo spine articles (baseline readability)
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Flesch Reading Ease) of LLM-simplified text versus original articles
links.effect: Baseline mean FKGL 9.5 and Reading Ease 51.1, above the AMA sixth-grade recommendation. LLM summaries gave statistically significant readability improvement, largest at the first iteration. The three LLMs performed similarly, though ChatGPT showed significantly greater Reading Ease gains. Specific post-simplification scores are not given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: No accuracy cost reported: accuracy stayed stable across iterations with no evidence of hallucination. Gemini included disclaimers most consistently.
links.quote: LLM summaries provided statistically significant improvement in readability, with the greatest improvements in the first iteration.

design_hint: LLM reading-level simplification of patient education materials
